title: Rubric - Accuracy
justification: All 30 criteria were examined for objective inaccuracy. Each criterion's assertions were verified against the prompt, gameplay_config.txt, the expected files (bomb_runtime_log.txt, bomb_blast_frame.png, Bomb_Chain_Reaction_Godot_Project.zip), and the input files (scene_reference.png, source_coin_token.png). Specific verifications: (1) All file names referenced in criteria match the actual expected/input file names. (2) The mechanic id 'bomb' in log criteria matches config [mechanic] id = bomb. (3) The 1.0s sampling interval in the expected log matches config telemetry_sample_interval_s = 1.0; criterion 10's +/-10% tolerance is internally consistent. (4) The ~3.0s auto-cycle gap between consecutive AUTO events in the expected log matches config auto_cycle_interval_s = 3.0; criterion 30's +/-20% tolerance is internally consistent. (5) MOTION_SAMPLE spans t=1.0 to t=41.0 (40 seconds, continuous with no gaps), confirming criterion 8's 12-second minimum. (6) ACTION_TRANSITION count increments sequentially 1-96 with no skips, confirming criterion 27. (7) The actions field in MOTION_SAMPLE lines never decreases and matches the most recent preceding ACTION_TRANSITION count (verified for multiple samples), confirming criterion 24. (8) Visual criteria (16-23, 25) accurately describe elements visible in the expected bomb_blast_frame.png and scene_reference.png: 3D bomb on the right, yellow oval tokens, blast ring, HUD on left, grid lines, COLLECT strip, title. (9) No two criteria impose logically contradictory requirements. No criterion asserts a fact that the prompt or source files contradict.
evidence: All criteria verified against gameplay_config.txt (mechanic id=bomb, auto_cycle_interval_s=3.0, telemetry_sample_interval_s=1.0, token_rows=4, tokens_per_row=5, strip_label=COLLECT), expected bomb_runtime_log.txt (MOTION_SAMPLE t=1.0 through t=41.0 at 1.0s intervals, ACTION_TRANSITION count 1-96 sequential, both AUTO and INPUT origins, ~3s between consecutive AUTO events), expected bomb_blast_frame.png (3D bomb panel right of board, yellow oval coins, blast ring, HUD column on left, grid lines, COLLECT strip, TD 2D . BOMB title), and scene_reference.png (matching visual layout).
